description: Clean naturalist field guide illustration with true-to-life coloration and even lighting.
prompt_block:
Style:
clean naturalist field-guide illustration in the tradition of a John James Audubon 1838 ornithological plate or an Ernst Haeckel natural history lithograph, semi-realistic with fine stippled detail, even flat lighting, true-to-life coloration, no dramatic shadows, museum-plate composition, reference-style consistency

notes: Default reference style for identification-oriented plates.

description: Delicate watercolor illustration with soft brush strokes and subtle pigment bleeding.
prompt_block:
